notes: Big enemies have moves (Tanks and Golems slam, Chasers lunge, big Spitters and Frostlings fire more, big Exploders leave fire). Bosses stomp and, enraged, sweep; each leaves their core exposed for extra damage, and the boss bar marks where they enrage. Allies level up more slowly and you choose a perk for them at Lv 3 and Lv 5. Phones draw at a lower resolution for a much smoother frame rate. New Run History on the title screen.
